test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cats are animals.

All animals are black.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some black are cats.

II. All cats are black.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb8171fa2e89993e969b3820c85f292f685ad5e24e197e7605a0ebd57ddcb2c5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some black are cats → Follow (As all cats are animals and all animals are black. As whole cats comes in animals which whole comes in black, therefore it is true.)

II. All cats are black → Follow (As all cats are animals and all animals are black. As whole cats comes in animals which whole comes in black, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
